description: This file contains utility functions and data structures for handling dispatch wrappers, including detection, unwrapping, and trust plan resolution for various command-line wrapper tools in a Unix-like environment.

methods.name: isDispatchWrapperExecutable
methods.description: Checks if a given token corresponds to a known dispatch wrapper executable.

methods.name: unwrapKnownDispatchWrapperInvocation
methods.description: Attempts to unwrap a command-line invocation if it is a known dispatch wrapper, returning the unwrapped arguments or indicating if it is not a wrapper.

methods.name: unwrapDispatchWrappersForResolution
methods.description: Resolves nested dispatch wrappers in command-line arguments up to a maximum depth, returning the final unwrapped argument list.

methods.name: hasDispatchEnvManipulation
methods.description: Determines if the command-line arguments involve environment manipulation via a dispatch wrapper.

methods.name: resolveDispatchWrapperTrustPlan
methods.description: Analyzes command-line arguments to produce a trust plan, indicating whether wrappers are trusted, blocked, or require further inspection.
